description: Follow White House, a tracked organization, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: The White House tried but failed to block funding for preschool for poor children. Instead, it will seek to strip away standards on health, literacy — and brushing teeth.

changes.title: Abortion is on the ballot again in these two states: From the Politics Desk
changes.summary: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

changes.title: Funding milestone detected
changes.summary: Nature, Published online: 24 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02332-8 Chief US science adviser calls for a shakeup in funding while handing out grants to accelerate research with AI.

changes.title: Trump cracks jokes at first White House Correspondents' Dinner
changes.summary: President Trump cracked jokes at the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night, after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.

changes.title: 'The show must go on.' Trump makes jabs at rescheduled White House Correspondents' dinner
changes.summary: President Trump used his speech to attack his political opponents, members of the media and even members of his own cabinet. (Image credit: Rod Lamkey).

changes.title: White House Correspondents' Association scholarship recipients relive terrifying dinner
changes.summary: Kaitlin Bender-Thomas and Madison Maynard, two White House Correspondents' Association scholarship recipients, join "The Daily Report" to reflect on April's terrifying shooting ahead of the rescheduled dinner.

changes.title: Trump returns to correspondents' dinner 3 months after shooting
changes.summary: President Donald Trump returned to the rescheduled White House Correspondents' Association dinner Friday night, delivering a rambling, hour-long speech. (Image credit: Rod Lamkey).

changes.title: Special Report: Trump delivers speech at rescheduled White House Correspondents’ Dinner
changes.summary: Watch President Donald Trump’s full speech at the White House Correspondents’ Dinner, which was rescheduled after a shooting at the previous dinner in April. Trump took swipes at some of the journalists in the room and some political rivals while touting his accomplishments.

changes.title: Trump says 'a lot was learned' from White House Correspondents' Dinner shooting
changes.summary: President Donald Trump thanks reporters and recalls the events of the night of the first White House Correspondents' Dinner earlier this year, where a gunman attempted to storm the room at the Washington Hilton.

changes.title: Trump speaks at White House Correspondents' Dinner, in redo after April attack
changes.summary: President Trump is attending the redo of the White House Correspondents' Dinner on Friday night, after an armed assailant upended April's dinner.
